sections.what_happened: [VERIFIED FACT -- the quotes] From the same CBS 60 Minutes interview whose Ukraine quotes were recorded at 0700-01, the Iran portion (missed by the 07:00 scan; carried in-window by AJ liveblog 03:45 GMT = 07:45 , JPost, Israel National News, TOI): Trump blamed the GOP midterm defeat on the Iran war, rising gasoline prices and 'a great dislike, incredibly, for Israel' ('They didn't like the war. They didn't like the fact that gasoline went up'). He said 'I don't think there's any reason to' escalate: 'They have nothing. It's buried under thousands of tons of rock.' On Pickaxe Mountain: 'We watch every one of those sites, the three that we blew up, and also Pickaxe Mountain. If we needed to do Pickaxe, which we don't at this moment, we would have that done in one hour.' On Hormuz: the strait is 'open' with 'ships going through'; countries the US protected 'are going to pay us back any and all costs... Without us, Israel would not exist.' 'We won in Iran. We won that in Iran. It's just a question of closing it out now or later.' 'We're choking it off' via Operation Iron Gate. On Iranian nuclear-material movement: 'We have not seen it.' [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- the substance] 'We won' / Iran's capability destroyed / Hormuz open are Trump's assertions only; no new independently verifiable intelligence assessment accompanies them (JBizNews notes this explicitly).
sections.what_verified: 5 distinct publisher families with declared tiers: Al Jazeera T2 (STATE QA), Jerusalem Post T3, Times of Israel T3, Times of India T3, Haaretz T3 -- all carrying the CBS transcript quotes. CBS itself is the primary source (tier undeclared in the registry). Attribution-only (NOT counted, no declared tier): Israel National News, JBizNews, News18.
sections.what_disputed: Trump's 'Hormuz open / ships going through' contradicts the counted record: IMF PortWatch counted 1 transit through Hormuz on 2026-11-01, 7-day average 4.43 vs 2025 baseline 85.53/day -- but that snapshot is STALE (8-day lag, fetched Nov 9 02:02 ), so no live count can be cited; the contradiction is recorded, not resolved. 'We won in Iran' vs Rubio the same day: 'no progress', Iranian demands 'unacceptable'/'outrageous'; Araghchi: mediators halted travel after the midterm 'shock'. No polling data was cited by Trump for the 'dislike of Israel' claim (JPost notes this). The IAEA has said it has no proof of a systematic Iranian effort to develop a nuclear weapon (AJ liveblog).
sections.why_matters: Trump admits on camera the war cost him Congress -- and names dislike of Israel as a reason. Reveal frame: the president who launched the war now says voters punished him for it, while claiming 'we won' and 'Hormuz is open' against a strait running at ~5% of normal transits (stale count, dated). Skeptical treatment throughout per NO-PRAISE lock: his claims are quoted, then checked.
